meta.title: DropFlow — drag, tap, convert. Offline.
meta.description: DropFlow is an open-source file converter for Windows and the web. Drag a file, tap a key, and a wheel converts, compresses or transcribes it on your device — nothing is uploaded.

hero.subtitle: A wheel appears while you drag a file. Convert, compress, merge or turn speech into text — right on your device. Nothing is ever uploaded.
hero.status: In development. The demo on this page is a simulation of the real app.

demo.label: Interactive demo of the DropFlow wheel
demo.hint: Choose a file, switch wheels with the keys below, then pick a wedge. Arrow keys also work.
demo.idle: Choose a wedge to run it on {file}.

stats.conversionsDesc: Across images, video, audio, documents, spreadsheets and archives.
stats.toolsDesc: Compress, crop, trim, split, merge, redact, transcribe and more.
stats.actionsDesc: Share, float, copy, move, copy path and terminal.

how.title: One gesture. Three wheels.
how.subtitle: Start dragging any file or folder, then tap a key. Keys are configurable.

convert.title: Convert
convert.text: Pick a target format. DropFlow saves a new copy beside the original.

tools.title: Tools
tools.text: Compress, crop, trim, split, merge, redact, transcribe — with a quick options panel when needed.

actions.title: Actions
actions.text: Share, keep on a floating shelf, copy, move, copy the path or open a terminal.

how.alt: Prefer the keyboard? Select a file, press Enter, switch wheels, pick with the arrow keys. Touch: hold, then drag.

explorer.title: Every format you actually use
explorer.subtitle: Pick a category to see what it converts to and which tools come with it.
explorer.noTools: Conversions only — file actions work on everything.

pdf.title: A complete PDF toolkit — offline
pdf.subtitle: Merge, split, compress, protect, convert to and from Word, PowerPoint, Excel and images. No upload, no page limits.
pdf.note: PDF → Word may change the layout, like every converter. Scanned pages use local OCR.

media.title: A media studio in your pocket
media.subtitle: Convert, compress and edit video and audio with a real encoder — then turn speech into text.

encoder.title: DropFlow Encoder
items: MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV and MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, Opus
H.264, H.265 and AV1 with GPU acceleration when available
Presets for WhatsApp, Discord, email, YouTube and Reels
Hit a target file size, or keep the same quality at a smaller size
Queue with progress, ETA and cancel

stt.title: Speech to text
items: Runs Whisper on your device — Arabic and 90+ languages
Export SRT, VTT, TXT or DOCX
Burn the subtitles into the video in one step
Models download only when you ask

privacy.title: Your files stay on your device.
privacy.text: Online converters need a copy of your file on their server. DropFlow does the work locally — in the Windows app and in your browser.

cards.title: Windows app
cards.text: Conversions run on your PC with open-source engines. Network is used only for engine and model downloads you approve.

cards.title: Web app
cards.text: Files are processed inside your browser with WebAssembly. No request carries file content.

cards.title: Open source
cards.text: GPL-3.0. Read the code, verify the claims, build it yourself.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.subtitle: Built in public, phase by phase.
